title.narrative: Sustainability of services for key populations in the MENA region - World - Multicountry MENA Key Populations (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Multicountry MENA Key Populations, HIV, Frontline AIDS (FA)This program has the following goals: Increased sustainability of services for PLHIV & KPs in MENA.. The objectives of this program are: CSOs and KP networks' organizational capacities and systems strengthened.. Innovative and sustainable community-led service delivery models developed, documented, implemented, and promoted.. Increase domestic financing for quality HIV prevention, treatment, and care services for KPs through public health systems, community systems or through social contracting in the five focus countries.. Reduction in structural barriers, including stigma and discrimination against KPs and improve their access to health services and retention in care.. Document human-rights violations against key populations and provide responses.. Scale-up comprehensive prevention programs for people who use drugs.
